description: This file defines a DashboardFragment class for an Android TV application. It manages a UI screen displaying a grid of devices, allowing toggling their on/off states via DPAD input, and showing a count of active devices.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Android Fragment representing the Dashboard UI with device controls and a count of active devices.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout for the dashboard.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView and adapter, and sets initial focus.

methods.name: updateCount
methods.description: Updates the display of the number of devices currently turned on.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of DashboardFragment.

methods.name: updateCount
methods.description: Counts devices with 'isOn' true and updates the TextView showing the count.
